description: This file defines a function createStore() that creates and registers a Blits plugin implementing a global store for recipe data. It manages state related to recipes, filtering, queries, selected recipe, repository type, and theme. It also contains methods for initializing data from mock or API repositories, filtering recipes based on search queries, selecting recipes, and switching data repositories.

methods.name: createStore()
methods.description: Creates and registers a Blits plugin for a global recipe store with methods to initialize data, filter recipes, select recipes, and switch repositories.
